text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen was such a dreamlike 
time! Everyone's passion, brilliance, and 
"dreams"! I could feel it all so vividly!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I got to run in this race! The 
"dreams" I received from everyone are 
still burning! I want to run in races 
where our "dreams" cross paths again!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The next target is the Sprinters Stakes! 
To become Oguri-senpai's ultimate rival, 
I'm gonna stand at the very top of the 
sprint division!
